messages:
Ashley Chen: Quick sync — procurement flagged APAC H200 lead times stretching out. We need a pragmatic reserve mix for July peak, and I want tradeoffs (latency, $/GPU-hour, booking risk).
Matt Rivera: Rough numbers? H200 ETA and H100/L40S alternatives?
Ashley Chen: H200: 14–18w for APAC racks. H100: 6–9w. L40S: in-stock for spot bursts but limited long-term warranty for some vendors.
Priya Patel: For capacity planning I translated this into GPU-hours. July peak forecast: ~2.6M token-hours/day -> ~3.9k effective GPU-hours/day on H200 (baseline batch/latency profile). If H200 delayed, we'd need ~30% more H100 nodes because of perf delta.
Cheng Wu: Can you drop the perf ratios? We used 1.0 H200 baseline, H100 ~0.75 effective, L40S ~0.45 for our seq lengths. That means for 3.9k H200-hours/day we need ~5.2k H100-hours or ~8.7k L40S-hours.
Samir Khan: Ops perspective: booking that much L40S is cheaper per-hour but increases operational overhead (more nodes, more failures). Also burst networks might spike egress costs in APAC.
Matt Rivera: What about mixing: reserved H200 for steady baseline, H100 for steady extra capacity, L40S as burst for cost spikes? Any vendor lead-time windows we can exploit?
Ashley Chen: Proposal: commit 60% baseline to H200 (reserved), 25% to H100 (shorter lead), 15% unreserved L40S burst. That gives us headroom and lower booking risk.
Priya Patel: Cost model quick calc: if H200 reserved unit cost = $1.00/GPU-hour, H100 equivalent cost = $0.85, L40S spot-ish = $0.45 but effective cost includes 20% ops tax and more burst egress. Net blended cost roughly $0.82/tokenized unit — within our target.
Cheng Wu: Network/regional constraint: APAC racks are constrained on freight windows in August — recommend earlier booking to push racked ops to June. If we wait into late Q2 pricing could also increase 8–12%.
Samir Khan: Also note datacenter space: H200 boards are denser -> cooling peak in those pods. We must reserve 10% extra PDU/CRAC headroom. Ops-scheduler, can you check rack footprints? @ops-scheduler
ops-scheduler: assigned ticket INF-5237 to validate PDUs and rack cooling for proposed H200 60% baseline. ETA: 3 working days.
Ashley Chen: Thanks. Two action items: 1) Procurement to open reserved H200 order for 60% baseline this week, 2) schedule H100 purchase window to fill 25% within 2–3 weeks.
Matt Rivera: On procurement: can we include flexible fallbacks (convert some H200 to H100 if ETA slips) — contract clause?
Samir Khan: Procurement said vendors will allow partial swaps with 4–6w notice but price delta applies. We should cap swap window.
Cheng Wu: For forecasting dashboard, I'll add a scenario row for "60/25/15 mix" and include GPU-hours, expected latency impact, and blended cost.
Ashley Chen: Perfect. Priya, Cheng — please update throughput projections and send to finance by EOD Friday. Procurement, loop in vendor contacts and push tentative PO for H200 with swap clause.
infra-bot: Reminder: previous reservation window closed 2025-11-12. New reservation requests may take 48–72h to process.
Matt Rivera: One last ask — can we pilot an L40S-only rack in APAC for 2 weeks to validate burst orchestration? If it looks good we can bump burst from 15% -> 25%.
Samir Khan: Happy to run the pilot. Need signoff on ephemeral budget (~$12k) and a short runbook.
Ashley Chen: Approved pilot budget. Samir, spin up runbook and target pilot start next Tue. Thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
__notes: This thread contains short, informal Slack messages discussing APAC hardware reservation strategy, lead times, capacity mix, cost math, and next steps.
